The '''Type 93 air-to-ship missile''' (93式空対艦誘導弾, '''ASM-2''') is an air-launched [[anti-ship missile]] developed in Japan. It was developed by using technology from the [[Type 88 surface-to-ship missile]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. Global Website {{!}} ASM-2 |url=https://www.mhi.com/products/defense/type93_air-to-ship_missile_asm_2.html |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. |language=en}}</ref>

This missile is used by the [[Japan Air Self-Defense Force]].

The ASM-2 will be replaced by the [[ASM-3]].
